failure_summary: render_decision.requiredSet lists only opp-major (c4r3), opp-major-line and better-col — it never obliges opp-fork-pivot (c4r2) or opp-fork-square/opp-double (c6r2), which ARE offered in zones.aliases, so all 3 runs name the opponent fork as the mechanism while leaving its creating square and its second winning square unlocatable (solver: after the played col6, opponent plays col4 -> finalMovestring 43421122112604010042053 shows <X> gravity-top fours at BOTH c4r3 and c6r2, all columns -9).
notes: A7 failed 3/3, deterministic. A7c: mechanism is explicitly a fork/double threat in every run, but c4r2 — the pivot that creates it, offered as zones.aliases handle opp-fork-pivot — is never named; the required set does not oblige it. A7b: the phrases "the fork" / "the same double threat" / "their double threat" promise a two-square object, yet only c4r3 is ever named or wrapped; c6r2 (opp-fork-square, and half of opp-double windows:c4r3,c6r2) appears in no run; run 0 additionally leaves "the key square in column 4" unwrapped and ambiguous between the two opponent majors c4r3 and c4r5 that visualize_board shows on the decision board. A7e is N/A: on the after-played board 4342112211260401004205 the opponent has NO gravity-top four (col4 height 1, majors c4r3/c4r5 both non-gravity-top), and eval-43 is not among the 10 records in the v3 measured-reach list. A5b N/A: player===2 but boardState is mid-game, not opening. A3/A4 pass on runs 0-1: the diagonal window c2r1,c3r2,c4r3,c5r4 and the c4r3 major are board-true on the decision board and are the decisive difference (after best col0 solver score 4 for the opponent vs 9 after played col5). G2 pass: the L3 guardrail is honored — no run says the played move caused the pattern, none says the player is lost, all three carry the toughest-defense frame with no defeatist closing clause. G5 pass: every rendered tactic entry is board-true (decision majors c4r3/c4r5 opp; projectedDeep majors c4r5 opp, c6r2 opp, c6r3 you). G7 pass: annotationRepairs empty, guardDiagnostics.failures empty, every emitted handle wraps a shape-matched phrase (line words on windows:, square words on c4r3/col handles). Sub-sampling per rubric: A3, A4, G2, G4, G5 graded on runs 0-1 only; run 2 is null (not scored, not a pass). A1/A2/A6 copied verbatim from grade_mechanical.mjs. Production-fidelity note: gpt-5.4-mini, but the attribution here is model-INDEPENDENT — the required set is what fails to oblige the pivot and the second fork square. All 3 runs had retry_fired=true with retry_reason missingHandles=[better-col].
